description: Day 1 of the demo (tools/LIVE-RUN.md): the deal call. The lines the user says, and the lines tools/walkthrough.py plays: 'audio' names the user's recording in fixtures/audio/, or 'voice' for speech generated as tests/mouth/voices.py makes it. 'then' is where Gawah should speak before the next line; 'spoken', if there, is what the generated voice reads (so the name Gawah comes out clearly). Times are estimates for a replay; the dry run waits on Gawah instead.

lines.speaker: hirer
lines.text: Main Sunita hoon. Main sehmat hoon.

lines.speaker: worker
lines.text: Main Ramesh, painter. Main bhi sehmat hoon.

lines.speaker: hirer
lines.text: Mujhe apna flat paint karwana hai. Two BHK hai, Indirapuram mein, third floor pe.

lines.speaker: worker
lines.text: Do coat aur putty ka touch-up, material ke saath pachees hazaar lagega madam.

lines.speaker: hirer
lines.text: Pachees hazaar bahut zyada hai. Mera budget twenty thousand ka hai.

lines.speaker: worker
lines.text: Madam bees mein nahi ho payega, labour hi teen aadmi ka hai. Chalo baees hazaar final kar lo.

lines.speaker: hirer
lines.text: Theek hai, twenty two thousand done. Lekin material aapka hoga, upar se koi extra charge nahi.

lines.speaker: worker
lines.text: Haan theek hai.

lines.speaker: worker
lines.text: Advance kitna doge madam? Material lene ke liye paanch hazaar toh pehle chahiye.

lines.speaker: hirer
lines.text: Theek hai, paanch hazaar advance.

lines.speaker: worker
lines.text: Ji madam, theek hai.

lines.speaker: hirer
lines.text: Chalo theek hai. Kaam kab se start karoge?

then.gawah: asks Sunita when the balance will be paid

lines.speaker: hirer
lines.text: Baaki paisa kaam poora hone ke din de dungi.

lines.speaker: worker
lines.text: Ji madam, theek hai.

lines.speaker: worker
lines.text: Agle somvaar se shuru kar denge, subah nau baje tak pahunch jayenge.

lines.speaker: hirer
lines.text: Aur khatam kab tak hoga? 15 tareekh ko mere ghar pe guests aa rahe hain.

lines.speaker: worker
lines.text: Paanch din ka kaam hai madam. Shukravaar tak finish, pandrah tareekh se pehle ho jayega.

lines.speaker: hirer
lines.text: Pakka?

lines.speaker: worker
lines.text: Pakka.

lines.speaker: worker
lines.text: Late hua to har din ka paanch sau kaat lena.

lines.speaker: hirer
lines.text: Theek hai, paanch sau kaat lena.

lines.speaker: worker
lines.text: Gawah ji, advance kitna tay hua tha?
lines.spoken: गवाह जी, advance कितना तय हुआ था?

then.gawah: says 'Haan ji, ek second', then the advance: 5,000

lines.speaker: hirer
lines.text: Chalo, sab tay ho gaya. Dhanyavaad Ramesh ji.

lines.speaker: worker
lines.text: Ji madam, dhanyavaad.

then.gawah: reads the terms back and asks both to say haan

lines.speaker: hirer
lines.text: Haan, sab sahi hai.

lines.speaker: worker
lines.text: Haan ji, sab sahi hai.

then.gawah: may thank them; nothing more is needed
